answer.value: A GitHub code repository (github.com/microsoft/phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B), a technical report, and a full data card describing the training data are linked. Evaluation logs are said to be released publicly later. The card says the model is on Hugging Face and Azure AI Foundry.
quotes: To learn more about the training data used for Phi-4-Reasoning-Vision-15B please refer to the full data card: https://huggingface.co/microsoft/Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B/blob/main/DATACARD.md.
Evaluation logs will be released publicly.
